review:
The series' first Christmas edition, and it sticks very close to the 2020 original: 5x3, 10 lines, and fish with cash values that only matter in the bonus.

Three or more scatters trigger free spins, where every wild collects all the fish on screen. Every fourth wild adds 10 spins and raises the multiplier to 2x, 3x and finally 10x – that last level is where the big results come from. Same 96.71% RTP as the original. Big Bass with snow and Christmas music.
